description.en: Adds realistic per-field soil management to Farming Simulator 25. Tracks Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Organic Matter, and pH for every field on the map. Crops deplete nutrients at harvest; fertilizers, manure, and lime replenish them. Rain causes leaching, seasons shift nitrogen levels, and neglected fields slowly recover on their own. Includes a live soil HUD, full farm soil report (K key), 25+ custom fertilizer types, field health tracking (weed, pest, disease), and three smart precision systems: Smart Sensor (blocks sections with no active need), See & Spray (live per-cell pressure overlay), and Variable Rate Application (auto boom rate from soil deficits). Free Panel Layout lets you drag and collapse each in-vehicle panel independently. Fully multiplayer with server-authoritative settings. Works on multifruit maps - unknown crops use a balanced fallback rate. Not compatible with Precision Farming: if Precision Farming is active for your savegame, this mod detects it and automatically disables itself to protect your soil data. Use one or the other.
